<!-- VM.plotting.draggablePoints on real Plotly charts. The first chart is
     the Buffon's-needle pattern (one point, box bounds, jump); its paint cell
     also draws a small Plotly marker at the value, which the check uses to
     see that the handle sits exactly where Plotly draws that data point,
     through a resize and a theme toggle. The second has three points. -->

```{ojs}
//| output: false
VM = window.VM
vmTheme = Generators.observe(notify => VM.plotting.onThemeChange(notify))
chartColors = VM.plotting.colors(vmTheme)
dropPlot = VM.plotting.persistentPlot({height: "360px"})
cornerPlot = VM.plotting.persistentPlot({height: "360px"})
```

<div class="vm-app" id="drop">

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

```{ojs}
viewof drop = VM.plotting.draggablePoints(dropPlot, {
  value: {x: 0.87, y: 0.42},
  xBounds: [0, Math.PI], yBounds: [0, 0.5],
  step: {x: 0.05, y: 0.01},
  jump: true,
  label: "Drop",
  format: p => `θ ${p.x.toFixed(2)}, d ${p.y.toFixed(2)}`
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
dropPlot([
  {x: [0, Math.PI, Math.PI, 0, 0], y: [0, 0, 0.5, 0.5, 0], mode: "lines", fill: "toself",
    fillcolor: VM.plotting.alpha(chartColors.muted, 0.12), line: {color: chartColors.ink}, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false},
  {x: [drop.x], y: [drop.y], mode: "markers", marker: {color: chartColors.alt, size: 4},
    hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false, name: "probe"}
], {
  xaxis: {range: [-0.1, Math.PI + 0.1], fixedrange: true},
  yaxis: {range: [-0.02, 0.52], fixedrange: true},
  dragmode: false, hovermode: false
}, {...VM.plotting.config(), displayModeBar: false})
```

</div>

```{ojs}
html`<p id="drop-readout">θ = ${drop.x.toFixed(3)}, d = ${drop.y.toFixed(3)}</p>`
```

</div>

<div class="vm-app" id="corners">

<div class="ojs-chart-block">

```{ojs}
viewof corners = VM.plotting.draggablePoints(cornerPlot, {
  value: [{x: 0, y: 0}, {x: 1, y: 0}, {x: 0.5, y: 0.8}],
  label: ["A", "B", "C"],
  color: "var(--vm-color-alt)"
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cornerPlot([{
  x: [...corners.map(p => p.x), corners[0].x], y: [...corners.map(p => p.y), corners[0].y],
  mode: "lines", line: {color: chartColors.alt}, hoverinfo: "skip", showlegend: false
}], {
  xaxis: {range: [-0.5, 1.5], fixedrange: true},
  yaxis: {range: [-0.5, 1.2], fixedrange: true},
  dragmode: false, hovermode: false
}, {...VM.plotting.config(), displayModeBar: false})
```

</div>

</div>
